data.narrative:
GenFab Co is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Matt Parlmer that has raised $510K to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broader comp universe of 9 private companies and 1 public peer (277810.KQ) in the robotics and manufacturing sector, though a sufficiently deep peer set at the same stage and valuation tier was not available for direct median benchmarking.

The stage-progression method, the only triangulation approach with sufficient applicability, uses total capital raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $1.3M. A peer-median approach was not viable: while 11 robotics and manufacturing peers exist in the broader database, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier companies produced insufficient datapoints (fewer than 3 required for statistical relevance). The private comparable set includes Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI, though detailed stage and valuation data from these peers did not support narrow-band triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.1M (low) to $1.5M (high), with a median point of $1.3M. This range is anchored to a single methodology and carries material uncertainty around stage-appropriate multiplier assumptions and the absence of tightly comparable peer valuations. Validation would benefit from additional seed-stage robotics company datasets or forward-looking revenue/funding trajectory data.
